The '''Ham joint''' is a [[Weapon_slot_table|one-handed weapon]] that is obtained as a rare reward from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

It is one of only four [[melee]] weapons with an [[attack speed]] of 3, with the other ones being the [[swift blade]], [[goblin paint cannon]], and [[mystic cards]], with the latter two also being two handed weapons only. The swift blade also exclusively uses [[Stab]] and [[Slash]] attack styles whereas the others use [[Crush]], and the mystic cards have negative combat stat bonuses whereas the others have no bonuses.
